SELECT board_seq.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO board (board_id, user_id, board_name, board_info, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{userId}, #{boardName}, #{boardInfo}, SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
mapper.select: SELECT board_id AS boardId, user_id AS userId, board_name AS boardName, board_info AS boardInfo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM board WHERE board_id = #{boardId}

SELECT b.board_id, b.board_name, b.board_info, b.updated_at, COUNT(sp.pin_id) AS pin_count, ( SELECT LISTAGG(p.image_url, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.pin_id) FROM ( SELECT p2.image_url, p2.pin_id FROM saved_pin sp2 JOIN pin p2 ON sp2.pin_id = p2.pin_id WHERE sp2.board_id = b.board_id ORDER BY sp2.saved_pin_id DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY ) p ) AS thumbnail_str FROM board b LEFT JOIN saved_pin sp ON b.board_id = sp.board_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY b.board_id, b.board_name, b.board_info, b.updated_at ORDER BY b.updated_at DESC
SELECT p.image_url, p.title, sp.pin_id, p.link_url FROM saved_pin sp JOIN pin p ON sp.pin_id = p.pin_id WHERE sp.board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET board_name = #{boardName}, board_info = #{boardInfo}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
